title: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of AI
summary: Stuart Russell is a professor of computer science at UC Berkeley and a co-author of the book that introduced me and millions of other people to AI, called Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach.   Video version is available on YouTube . If you would like to get more information about this podcast go to https://lexfridman.com/ai or connect with @lexfridman on Twitter , LinkedIn , Facebook , or YouTube where you can watch the video versions of these conversations.
